answer: Newcomers must complete a voyage: a chain of real jobs across five different public ports, each leg stamped by a different established peer who re-runs the work before signing. A comet audit streaks across the ledger at random intervals and demands live proof of one random leg within minutes, which a forged leg cannot produce in time. Every verified leg dyes the agent's stake a deeper sable, a permanent mark earned only by sustained honest work, while a failed comet check leaves a public scar that bars the agent from every port until trust is re-earned leg by leg.
